summary: Choose a profession and follow two exact starter recipes into the Orichalcum equipment chain.
quickAnswer: Blacksmithing makes melee weapons and Guards; Handicrafting makes bows, staffs and jewelry. One Orichalcum Longsword needs 3 Ingots, 5 Refining Stones and 2 Odyle; each Ingot needs 2 Ore and 1 Solvent.
